definitions.explanation: Tears shed out of happiness, for example at good news, a reunion or a victory.

examples.japanese: {嬉|うれ}し{涙|なみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嬉|うれ}し{涙|なみだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I cried tears of joy at the news that I had passed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{抱|だ}き{合|あ}って→抱き合う：32504_dakiau⟧{嬉|うれ}し{涙|なみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: The moment their victory was decided, the players hugged each other and wept for joy.

notes:
From ⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧ (happy) + ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧ (tears); the adjective drops its final い. Also written うれし{涙|なみだ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嬉|うれ}し{涙|なみだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to shed tears of joy
- {嬉|うれ}し{涙|なみだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}れる→暮れる：31225_kureru⟧: to be overcome with tears of joy
- {嬉|うれ}し{涙|なみだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ / ⟦こぼれる→こぼれる：02105_koboreru⟧: tears of joy come / spill

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悔|くや}し{涙|なみだ}: tears of frustration, after a defeat
- {感涙|かんるい}: tears of deep emotion (written, formal)
